one_liner: LiveAgent helpdesk has a documented REST API v3 with admin-generated API keys, a 30-day free trial, and a vendor-built MCP server.
auth_notes: The REST API v3 uses a static API key sent in a header (admin generates it under Configuration > System > API). OAuth 2.1 is documented only for the MCP server, not the main REST API. The Python SDK mentions an OAuth2 access token for 'privileges', but self-serve app registration is not shown.
access_notes: A 30-day free trial with no credit card is available, and the docs recommend a trial account for API testing. No permanent free tier is shown. The MCP server is listed under the Enterprise plan, which is sold through sales.
blocker_notes: Credentials come only from a 30-day trial. After that a paid plan is needed. Each customer has its own domain and API key, so multi-user access means collecting a key plus a domain. The trial is long enough to build and test, so this is minor friction.

evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.
There are two ways to authenticate your MCP client - **OAuth 2.1 (recommended)**, where the AI tool discovers the authorization server automatically
Consider registering a new [free Trial account](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/) for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
LiveAgent exposes a built-in **MCP server** (Model Context Protocol) that lets you connect external AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude Desktop, Cursor
